lineage: game-compiler - Sony/Cygnus 2.9-ee-991111b (game/textbin route; replaces the SN binary as parity lands)
role: R5900 short-loop padding placement: a single pad NOP is emitted before the instruction preceding the branch, so the delayed-branch filler examines that instruction first (allowing a movn to fill the delay slot) while the NOP stays in front of the branch as a fallback, matching the retail layout. The loop length counts the branch itself when the preceding instruction is a slot candidate.
mechanism: gcc/config/mips/mips.c mips_r5900_lengthen_loops(): compute stealable = preceding non-note insn is a plain INSN; pads = 7 - (distance + (stealable ? 1 : 0)); anchor = preceding insn when stealable and pads == 1; emit nops before the anchor.

evidence.out_of_scope: 4 sdk/* units regress under the game compiler; those units are built by the native EE-GCC 2.9 route and are out of this patch stack's scope
evidence.movn_root_cause: pre-dbr pad NOPs sat between the movn and the branch, so the filler stole the NOP; retail and the SN 2.95.2 oracle both put the movn (insn code 506) into the slot
